summary: Explores experimental scenarios for integrating Information-Centric Networking (ICN) into 4G mobile networks. Today each mobile user receives a separate unicast stream of media, which is inefficient for bandwidth and routing. The document looks at how ICN could improve content delivery, including with multicast-style broadcast. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Today every phone gets its own copy of a video, even if many want the same one. This looks at asking for content by name so the network can share copies.

questions: how can icn be used in 4g networks
what is information-centric networking in mobile networks
